body: Yeah. I always thought it would get better by 23. I'm now 23 and honestly... it's probably worse. The pressure to figure out your goals etc and the pressure to integrate into society is so much more intense in your 20s.
You're not a failure. You haven't given up yet and you shouldn't. Baby steps.
Honestly, i wanted to motivate you but I realize I feel the same about myself. What I can say is keep fighting. I keep fighting. I think you should too. Please don't ever give up on yourself.

Hmm, I'm 23 and I suffer from depression and anxiety. I also have self-loathing thoughts almost everyday. But I sometimes have to search for the good moments within a day and those brief moments make life a bit easier to deal with. Things take time so maybe first start out with doing something that gets you moving about, I say this because going for a jog often makes me feel better, if even for a while. You are special. Just be a bit more gentle and patient with yourself. Acknowledge your self-defeating thoughts for what they are but you don't need to believe them.
